thread.title: Netanyahu: Israel Is Seizing Territory in Gaza to Pressure Hamas on Hostages
thread.title_full: Netanyahu: Israel Is Seizing Territory in Gaza to Pressure Hamas on Hostages

author: Bshaky
text:
There is no hope for peace, as Hamas and many Palestinians still want to destroy Israel. But at least Israel can do what it needs to do to contain a violent enemy.
Hamas is very clear about who they are and what they want. Read their charter.
https://avalon.law.yale.edu/21st_century/hamas.asp
Their sole purpose is to destroy Israel and to remove all Israelis, from "every inch" of "Palestine". Many of them refer to their history, which includes the Crusaders who took over the area but were eventually defeated and evicted. Saladin conquered Jerusalem in 1187. You'll notice that many streets and people in this area are named after him - the man who defeated the Western (Christian) forces. It's a reflection of their view that with time, the Israelis will be pushed back to the sea. That's not likely to happen, but belief is a strong thing.
https://www.worldhistory.org/article/1553/saladins-conquest-of-jerusalem-1187-ce/#:~:text=Saladin%20(l.,took%20Jerusalem%20later%20that%20year.
